Implementation Plan

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-8814` at `8457391b19523ce0dbe5f55296792d8495eb86fe` (integration branch mismatch: false).

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends the per-doc ledger entry format of `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (last entry `### \`analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-01.md\``)
Scope-mode justification: The issue asks for two edits: delete one source doc and append one ledger entry with verdicts that were checked when the project was split into issues. No code, workflow, test or registry changes. The entry copies the layout of the 2026-10-01 entry (heading, `Source doc:`, `Processed:`, `Source commit:`, then a 3-column table), so no new structure is needed. Complete and shortcut versions cost about the same, so the plan writes every verdict row the issue lists, after re-checking each evidence anchor, rather than a shortened summary. This follows the §6 priority order (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed): a full, grounded record serves correctness.

## Files likely to change
- `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-01-2.md` (deleted)
- `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` (one entry appended at end of file)

## Functions or modules to implement
None. Documentation and analysis-artefact edits only:
1. Optionally read `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-01-2.md` (the doc being processed) only to confirm the recommendation labels, then delete it. Do not read, modify or delete any other file under `analysis/`. Never touch `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` or `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json`.
2. Append to `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`. The file currently ends with a table row followed by a newline. Add one blank line, then:
   - ``### `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-01-2.md` ``
   - ``Source doc: `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-10-01-2.md` ``
   - `Processed: <date -u +%F at implementation time>` (expected 2026-11-04)
   - ``Source commit: `22368d37acedfd955de34c60d7c7c8d276d6f715` ``
   - a blank line, then `| Recommendation | Verdict | Evidence / reason |` and `|---|---|---|`
   - one row per verdict below, then a trailing newline.
3. Leave the `## Processed source docs (128)` list alone. It stops at `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-09-26.md`, and the later entries (2026-09-28, 09-28-2, 09-28-3, 09-29, 09-30, 09-30-2, 10-01) were never added to it. The issue says to update it only if earlier entries kept it current, and they did not.

## Data structures affected
Markdown ledger only. Nothing parses the new rows. `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` (line 341) only runs `grep -qF` for a candidate doc's basename in the report, and only for docs that still exist. Once the doc is deleted, the new heading just records that it was processed.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Leave the "Processed source docs (128)" list untouched
- Chosen: no edit to the header list or its count.
- Alternatives considered: add the doc and bump the count to 129; backfill the missing 09-28 to 10-01 docs.
- Why: the issue says to update the list only if earlier entries kept it current. The 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-01 entries were not added to it, and backfilling would go beyond the append-only scope. The header says 128 but the list has 129 bullets; that existing mismatch also stays as it is.

### D2 — Cite the sibling fix by changelog fragment and `Refs #8814`, not a guessed PR number
- Chosen: cite `changelog.d/wfopt-2026-10-01-2-sweep-snapshot-parse.md` (Refs #8814). Add the merged PR number only if the integration branch's git history shows it, for example in a merge-commit subject.
- Alternatives considered: invent or look up a PR number.
- Why: the fragment contains only `Refs #8814`, and implement cannot query GitHub. The previous entry did the same (`(Refs #8796)`). The issue forbids inventing evidence.

### D3 — No test change
- Chosen: do not edit `tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py`.
- Alternatives considered: follow the advisory "Expected files" list.
- Why: the test builds its own report files in temporary directories (line 108) and never reads the real report or this doc. The issue's discipline and acceptance sections require `git diff --stat` to show only the two analysis paths.

## Security considerations
- No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or executable surface is touched. This is a Markdown append plus one file deletion.
